chapters.title: First Impressions
chapters.description: Let's break the ice and see what you noticed.

questions.text: Be honest — on a scale of 'meh' to 'I stalked your Instagram twice,' how excited were you for today?
What's the first thing you noticed about me that you'd never admit out loud?
If you had to rate my texting game out of 10 before today, what would it be — and why so harsh?
Pick one: my smile, my voice, or my sense of humor. You have to choose, no cheating.

mission.text: No phones for the next three minutes. Just look at each other and try not to laugh.

chapters.title: Getting Comfortable
chapters.description: Diving a little deeper (and a little more shameless).

questions.text: What's your most embarrassing celebrity crush that you'd only confess on a first date?
Would you rather I be a great cook or a great dancer? Pick fast, I'm judging the pause.
What's the cheesiest pickup line you'd secretly melt for, even if you'd roast it in public?
If we got matching tattoos today on a dare, what terrible thing would we get?

mission.text: Choose the next song to play — bonus points if it's a little too romantic for how long we've known each other.

questions.text: If we had to run away together today with only what's in your bag, what's our getaway plan?
What's a totally unnecessary skill you have that would somehow make me fall for you?
Give me a nickname right now. You can't overthink it, just say it.
What's the most embarrassing thing you'd do to win my attention in a room full of people?

mission.text: Take one selfie together — but you both have to make the most awkward face possible.

chapters.title: Chemistry
chapters.description: Let's see if we're actually on the same page.

questions.text: On a scale of 1 to 10, how's the chemistry going right now? You have to answer before you overthink it.
What's something about me that's more attractive in person than you expected?
If I tried to hold your hand right now, would you let me — and don't just say yes to be nice.
What would it take for today to end with a second date already planned?

mission.text: Maintain eye contact for 30 seconds. No talking, no laughing — good luck.

chapters.title: Future
chapters.description: Looking ahead, whatever that might mean.

questions.text: If I planned our second date, what's one thing it absolutely has to include?
What's a silly couple thing you've always wanted to do but never had the right person for?
Be honest — are you already thinking about what you'd tell your friends about today?
If today was a movie, what would the last line before the credits be?

mission.text: Just sit in the moment for a bit. No talking, no phones — let it sink in.
